title: Keep snapshot publication for the tested standalone Uniform route
question: Does terminal publication alone save repeatable elapsed time with the ordinary merge width?
summary: The 8 GiB screen removes 8.59 GB of managed reads and writes each and passes the late peer control. Paired elapsed changes are +3.852 and −0.349 seconds saved. It misses the wall-time gate.

workloads: 8 GiB standalone Uniform Shuffle, one worker and explicit 256 MiB, WSL2 ext4 and ordinary host headroom.

validation.summary: Both matched pairs independently verify seven strict-cap CSVs and cleanup. Both ordinary-width encoders complete with the same 530,512,996-byte late peer.

limitations: Two verified pairs before the declared stop. Ordinary host headroom and uncontrolled cache on one WSL host.
exclusions: Native Windows, WASI and physical device I/O.
reopen_when: Identify a standalone workload with a repeatable, meaningful absolute elapsed benefit from publication alone or qualify a safe merge change under the same late admission conditions.
